summary: A depth acknowledgement with a book but no open, high, low or close (no trade yet): the desktop frames the book with the quote fields it lacks left out; the web drops the acknowledgement uncached, so its next Depth frame has only that update's fields and a book of zeros around them.

notes: The web returns before caching a dk that carries none of o, h, l, c (definedge_adapter.py:809-821).

No frame carries the depth feed's `ltt` (an IST HH:MM:SS): the desktop reads it on the IST day the tick arrives (streaming.rs clock_on_day_of), so its epoch-ms value depends on the day the case runs and cannot be pinned here; brokers::definedge::tests::quote_feed::a_depth_message_carries_the_full_quote_and_the_trade_time pins it. Without it both sides take the feed time `ft` (epoch seconds) as the trade time.

deviations.reason: Definedge's web adapter puts its subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full). Lead rule 2026-11-09: data.mode follows the broker's own web adapter, in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (Definedge: integer).

The web forwards Definedge's raw time as ltt: the feed time `ft` in epoch seconds (or the depth feed's clock text HH:MM:SS), a wrong value where feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md); it is a JSON string as well. The desktop sends the epoch ms value.
The web sends the best bid quantity (Definedge `bq1`); the desktop's common carrier drops it.
deviations.ref: audit REMAINING_BROKERS 'Verified broker fields dropped by the common carrier' (definedge), definedge_adapter.py:987-1012; lane wire

deviations.reason: The web's Depth payload names the book total total_buy_qty beside total_buy_quantity; the desktop sends total_buy_quantity only.
The web drops a depth acknowledgement without OHLC before caching it (definedge_adapter.py:809-821), so a Depth subscriber gets nothing for the book Definedge sent; the desktop frames it.

Having dropped the acknowledgement, the web builds the next Depth frame from the update alone: every level but the one updated quantity reads 0 (price 0.0 at level one). The desktop keeps the acknowledged book and applies the update to it.
The web lost the acknowledged sell total with the dropped acknowledgement; the desktop keeps it.
